simplesect.para: ::translate for general information on the translate methods.

briefdescription.para: Translate Inst into its corresponding MachineInstr instruction(s).

detaileddescription.para: Insert the newly translated instruction(s) right where the CurBuilder is set.

The general algorithm is:
Look for a virtual register for each operand or create one. 2 Update the VMap accordingly. 2.alt. For constant arguments, if they are compile time constants, produce an immediate in the right operand and do not touch ValToReg. Actually we will go with a virtual register for each constants because it may be expensive to actually materialize the constant. Moreover, if the constant spans on several instructions, CSE may not catch them. => Update ValToVReg and remember that we saw a constant in Constants. We will materialize all the constants in finalize. Note: we would need to do something so that we can recognize such operand as constants.
Create the generic instruction.

memberdef.name: findUnwindDestinations

briefdescription.para: When an invoke or a cleanupret unwinds to the next EH pad, there are many places it could ultimately go.

detaileddescription.para: In the IR, we have a single unwind destination, but in the machine CFG, we enumerate all the possible blocks. This function skips over imaginary basic blocks that hold catchswitch instructions, and finds all the "real" machine basic block destinations. As those destinations may not be successors of EHPadBB, here we also calculate the edge probability to those destinations. The passed-in Prob is the edge probability to EHPadBB.
